name: Fire Bolt
description: A mote of fire streaks toward a target, dealing fire damage on impact.

name: Guidance
description: A gentle whisper of divine insight aids the recipient's next skill check.

name: Magic Missile
description: Three glowing darts of magical force strike unerringly at chosen targets.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature touched by the caster regains a portion of lost health.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: A string of insults laced with subtle magic causes the target psychic pain.

name: Fireball
description: A bright streak flashes to a point before erupting into a roaring blast of flame.

name: Healing Word
description: A quick word of divine power mends wounds from a distance.

name: Suggestion
description: The caster plants a subtle command in the target's mind, compelling reasonable action.
